appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Kairos matches your phone's appearance by default. Force a scheme here if you'd rather.
appearance.systemMeta: Follows your device and flips when your OS does.
appearance.lightMeta: Always light, regardless of the device.
appearance.darkMeta: Always dark, easier on the eyes at night.

language.title: Language
language.intro: Kairos follows your phone's language by default. Choose a language here to override it.
language.systemMeta: Uses your device language when Kairos supports it, otherwise English.
language.inProgressMeta: Screens not yet translated appear in English.
language.restartNote: Your choice applies straight away and is remembered on this device.

signup.title: Join Kharis Church
signup.completeNext: You'll complete your profile and pick your branch next.

forgotPassword.heading: Reset password

forgotPassword.sentTo: If an account exists for <1>{{email}}</1>, we've sent a link to reset your password. It expires in 30 minutes.
forgotPassword.notSeeing: Don't see it? Check your spam folder or try again with a different email.

resetPassword.heading: Reset password

verifyEmail.heading: Verify email
verifyEmail.onceApproved: Once an admin approves your account, you can sign in.

pendingApproval.title: Account pending approval
pendingApproval.body: Thanks for signing up. A church administrator will review your account shortly. We'll send you a notification the moment you're approved.
